_comment: Main question set v2 for scripts/bench.py (step 5c), written after the step 5 review. questions.json (v1) stays frozen for history. Differences from v1: (1) strict_coverage: the harness checks, with Postgres stemming, that every 'paraphrase' has coverage 0 on its gold memory and every 'paraphrase_stem' shares a stem (q17 page/paging, week/weekly; q20 Europe/European, night/nightly are relabelled, not edited); (2) every paraphrase has exactly one gold memory (v1's q14 and q15 had two, which doubled the chance of a hit); (3) 6 more direct and 12 more paraphrase questions over memories v1 and the holdout never asked about; (4) 9 more weak queries that share an ordinary word with the corpus (release, payment, migration, queue, database, invoice, deploy, backup, rotate) but are off topic. Run with --distractors 2000 for the headline numbers.
